name: Paris
headline: A side street with a point of view.
summary: Four hotels at $150 or under for 10–11 November 2026, plus the Plaza Athénée as the splurge.
intro: The Paris edit is four hotels whose Booking.com rate for 10–11 November 2026, two adults, was $150 or under, each with a score of 8.5 or higher. They run from rue de Liège and the Luxembourg Gardens to Montparnasse and Gare du Nord. The splurge is separate: Hôtel Plaza Athénée on Avenue Montaigne, priced like a palace.
